# The Kitten Cradle

> A nonprofit kitten rescue and foster organization in Shreveport, Louisiana dedicated to saving young cats through adoption, fostering, and community programs.

The Kitten Cradle operates a comprehensive rescue program featuring adoption services, foster-to-adopt programs, volunteer opportunities, and community outreach including TNR (trap-neuter-return) projects. The organization provides resources for kitten health, emergency care, and adoption support.

## Key Topics

- Foster-to-Adopt Program
- Kitten Adoption
- Foster Care
- Volunteer Opportunities
- Fading Kitten Syndrome

## Adoption & Foster-to-Adopt

- [Adoption](https://thekittencradle.org/adoption): Main adoption process page with survey and Foster-to-Adopt program
- [Adoption Application](https://thekittencradle.org/adoption-application): Adoption application form for prospective cat adopters
- [Foster-To-Adopt](https://thekittencradle.org/foster-to-adopt): Foster-to-Adopt Program details with trial period and pet placement

## Fostering & Volunteering

- [Fostering](https://thekittencradle.org/fostering): Kitten foster program application and care requirements
- [Volunteering](https://thekittencradle.org/volunteering-2): Volunteering overview for animal rescue and community involvement
- [Volunteer Sign Up](https://thekittencradle.org/volunteering): Volunteer signup form with availability and interest scheduling

## Kitten Health & Emergency Care

- [Fading Kitten Syndrome: What You Need to Know](https://thekittencradle.org/%f0%9f%90%b1-fading-kitten-syndrome-what-you-need-to-know): Guide to Fading Kitten Syndrome with warning signs and emergency response
- [What Happens After Intake: The First 72 Hours](https://thekittencradle.org/%f0%9f%90%be-what-happens-after-intake-the-first-72-hours-at-the-kitten-cradle): Guide to kitten intake process, health assessment, and first 72 hours
- [Toxic Plants & Your Cat: What to Watch Out For](https://thekittencradle.org/blog-with-right-sidebar/toxic-plants-your-cat-what-to-watch-out-for): Guide to toxic plants and cat safety for foster and pet owners

## Community Programs & Services

- [The Kitten Cradle TNR Project](https://thekittencradle.org/%f0%9f%92%9c-the-kitten-cradle-tnr-project): TNR Project for community cats with trap-neuter-return and colony management
- [Kitten Surrender](https://thekittencradle.org/services): Kitten surrender and intake closure service for rescue and foster care

## Support & Donations

- [Donations](https://thekittencradle.org/donations): Donation page with multiple payment options for nonprofit giving
